channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Trump says ‘big decision’ coming on Iran war as he prepares to meet six Gulf leaders at UN General Assembly
item.description: Trump said his next move on Iran would be influenced by discussions with leaders of six Gulf countries whom he is due to meet in New York next Tuesday on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.

item.title: Israeli envoy Danny Danon calls for Mamdani’s arrest ahead of Netanyahu’s New York visit
item.description: Speaking to reporters at the UN on Thursday, Danon accused Mamdani of incitement and of collaborating with an enemy of the United States. His remarks came days before Netanyahu is expected to address the UN General Assembly.

item.title: Intense Heat Strains Power Grids for 100 Million North Americans
item.description: Power grids serving more than 100 million North Americans are bracing for a demand surge as unseasonable heat strains electrical equipment scheduled for repairs.

item.title: Travis Scott, PinkPantheress, Keith Richards: GTA 6 unveils first six singles from upcoming album, check artists
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack album will be released alongside the video game on November 19. &nbsp;It consists of 34 tracks.

item.title: Canada steps up India trade talks, fourth CEPA round underway
item.description: Canada's international trade minister is visiting Mumbai to accelerate negotiations on a bilateral economic partnership aimed at doubling trade to 70 billion Canadian dollars by 2030.&nbsp;

item.title: Passport rules 2026: Children under 15 get new validity terms; Check revised fresh, renewal and tatkaal fees
item.description: Under the amended rules, a 36-page ordinary passport issued to a child below 15 years of age will be valid for five years from the date of issue or until the child turns 18, whichever comes first.

item.title: Delhi horror: Four teenagers held over gang-rape, murder of 16-year-old girl; here's how police cracked the case
item.description: A 19-year-old man was arrested and three minors apprehended in connection with the gang-rape and murder of a 16-year-old girl in north Delhi. Her body was found with multiple stab wounds, and knives linked to the crime have been recovered.

item.title: This ‘weird cat’ had scientists stunned—It’s a new species discovered after 100 years
item.description: The finding is significant because it represents the first new felid species discovered in more than a century. The previous new cat species was the pampas cat, described in 1923.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee losing TMC? Election Commission freezes Trinamool Congress name and party symbol
item.description: The Election Commission has frozen the name and symbol of Mamata Banerjee’s Trinamool Congress. Meetings with 'Kalighat Trinamool' and 'Ritobroto Trinamool' resulted in an interim order.

item.title: China warns against linking tariffs to Russian oil purchases, says it will not accept ‘long-arm jurisdiction’
item.description: The warning came after the US House of Representatives passed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act 2026, which authorises President Donald Trump to impose sanctions on Russia and steep tariffs on major buyers of Russian energy.

item.title: Mumbai's Olympia Coffee House, where Christopher Nolan, Matt Damon had chai, faces FDA licence suspension; here's why
item.description: The Maharashtra FDA, led by Tukaram Mundhe, has intensified inspections leading to the immediate suspension of Olympia Coffee House's food license due to serious hygiene violations. This action was part of the 'Safe Food Safe Maharashtra' campaign following a consumer complaint.

item.title: CM Rekha Gupta, CM Yogi, Amit Shah and more: BJP leaders celebrate PM Modi's birthday with Ashirwad Ka Diya program
item.description: On PM Narendra Modi's birthday, BJP leaders including Rekha Gupta, Yogi Adityanath, Amit Shah, Kangana Ranaut and more were seen taking part in Ashirwad Ka Diya events across India. Watch videos and pictures inside.

item.title: UPI MDR: PCI fact-checks Kerala Congress' ₹146 claim on ₹30,924 diesel payment, says charge is ₹5
item.description: The Payments Council of India disputes Kerala Congress's claim that a 0.4% UPI merchant discount rate on fuel payments affects petrol pump operators' margins, clarifying that a flat MDR of ₹5 applies instead to transactions over ₹2,000, not a percentage-based rate.

item.title: World’s coolest neighbourhoods 2026: 2 Indian spots make the cut — See where
item.description: The 2026 list of world’s coolest neighbourhoods reflects how neighbourhoods are increasingly being defined not just by major landmarks, but by their local businesses, food, culture and sense of community.

item.title: IndiGo revises add-on fees: Infant travel gets costlier, excess baggage now ₹800/kg | Here's how much you have to pay
item.description: IndiGo has increased prices for several add-on services, including infant travel, unaccompanied minor assistance, priority boarding, and excess baggage. For example, infant travel fees rise to ₹3,000 and excess baggage costs ₹800 per kg. Check fees when planning your travel expenses.

item.title: Centre steps up land monetisation with RINL’s 459-plot auction, three-city roadshow
item.description: NLMC will hold investor roadshows in Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, and Hyderabad next week to drive the October e-auction of 459 RINL land parcels.

item.title: India’s steel exporters get wider EU access even before FTA kicks in
item.description: A new 1.9-million-tonne country-specific quota, plus residual access, could allow India to ship up to 2.8 million tonnes of steel annually to the EU

item.title: UN experts flag two US strikes in Iran over possible war crimes: Which ones?
item.description: The experts said the findings were reached despite difficulties caused by the ongoing conflict, displacement and an internet shutdown in Iran, as well as limited cooperation from both governments.

item.title: Amid govt's proposal for CCTVs at medical stores, 64% of consumers say chemists rarely ask for prescription: Survey
item.description: India has proposed amending the Drugs Rules, 1945 as per a gazette notification on 8 September. It aims to curb the unauthorised sale of prescription drugs.

item.title: UPI MDR decision: FinMin rejects claims of US influence, says NPCI rules aim to support domestic competition
item.description: The clarification comes amid allegations from some Opposition parties, including the Congress, that the government had introduced the 0.4% MDR following pressure from the US.

item.title: Here comes an app to split UPI payments into ₹1,999 instalments: Social media reacts, ‘Can be easily flagged for fraud’
item.description: Effective October 15, 2026, merchant payments over ₹2,000 will incur a 0.4% charge. The app apparently tries to solve that ‘problem’.

item.title: Delhi monsoon: 8% more rain despite deficit across Haryana, Punjab, says report; here's why
item.description: Delhi has received 8% more rainfall than normal this monsoon, contrasting with neighboring regions facing deficits. This anomaly may be due to changing weather patterns linked to El Niño and climate change, affecting low-pressure systems and boosting rainfall in the capital.

item.title: Rainfall to remain widespread across several regions over next week
item.description: India Meteorological Department has forecast spells of rain accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning across central, eastern, western and southern regions.

item.title: Indian students face tough choices as Australia restricts family visas: Inside Canberra’s sharp immigration turn
item.description: The changes come as political pressure over Australia's high migration levels grows, with the hard-right One Nation party gaining ground in recent opinion polls.

item.title: UPI payments: GST on MDR applicable, but customers should not bear merchant charges, government sources say
item.description: Customers will not incur merchant payment charges as the government ensures businesses don't pass these costs on. Officials are monitoring the implementation closely.&nbsp;

item.title: Two Jaish-e-Mohammad terrorists killed, one suspect detained in Jammu & Kashmir's Udhampur operation
item.description: Two suspected members of the JeM were killed in Udhampur, Jammu and Kashmir, during a security operation involving the Army, police, and CRPF. An over-ground worker was detained. The operation continues with heightened surveillance to neutralize any remaining threats in the region.

item.title: Registration of Births and Deaths Bill to take effect from Oct 1: What does it mean? Who will be effected?
item.description: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Act was passed by both Houses of Parliament. The new law amended Section 13(3) of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969.

item.title: Delhi HC sets aside Amazon Web Services tax reassessment over ₹4,500 crore remittances, sends case for fresh look
item.description: Hearing AWS’s plea against the reassessment order, the court held that the company should be given a personal hearing and an opportunity to explain whether the transactions had already been examined in an earlier assessment.

item.title: US House passes Russia sanctions bill: Why Kremlin says it will ‘complicate’ Ukraine peace efforts
item.description: The US House has passed a Russia sanctions bill that could allow tariffs of up to 100% on countries, including India, that buy Russian oil and gas. The Kremlin warned that new sanctions could complicate efforts to reach a peace deal in Ukraine.

item.title: Australian immigration crackdown: New ballot system, working holiday visas - Are Indians impacted? What about students?
item.description: Australia will restrict most international students from bringing partners or children, part of a visa overhaul to cut net migration to 225,000. India isn't exempt, though PhD students keep family access. Existing families in Australia won't be separated.

item.title: India proposes mandatory CCTVs at medical stores to regulate prescription drug sales
item.description: The installation of CCTV systems is intended to enhance transparency and accountability across the pharmaceutical supply chain while protecting public health.

item.title: Xi Jinping health rumours: Unverified stroke post after BRICS Summit gets ‘Community Note’ on X
item.description: Wanjun's post on social media claimed that Xi was flown back to Beijing for emergency treatment at the People's Liberation Army General Hospital, commonly known as 301 Hospital. Wanjun is the chairman of the China Democracy Party (CDP), which has been banned in China.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi birthday: After US, Russia, Nepal, Vietnam leaders, Giorgia Meloni pens heartfelt wish to Indian ‘friend’
item.description: Russian President Vladmir Putin, and the embassies of the US, Vietnam, the Netherlands and Nepal wished Prime Minister Narendra Modi on his 76th birthday on Thursday.

item.title: Could China steal F-35 tech through Saudi Arabia deal? Report flags link amid Beijing's past record
item.description: A US intelligence assessment warns that China's military relationship with Saudi Arabia could allow access to sensitive F-35 technology if a proposed $24 billion arms deal is approved. Concerns arise over potential espionage and the presence of Chinese telecommunications equipment in Saudi networks.

item.title: 'Count your days': US Labor Department ramps up H-1B fraud probe amid increased scrutiny
item.description: The US Labour Department’s H-1B fraud investigation is expanding beyond the technology sector, with whistleblower tips and field inspections helping investigators identify suspected abuses involving employers, recruiters and labour brokers.
